chunks: Hazlam bin Bashir narrated, he said: I said to Ali bin Husain (peace be upon them): Describe to me the rise of the Mahdi and inform me of his proofs and signs.

He said: Before his advent, a man will appear whose name is Auf al-Salami in the land of Jazira, his dwelling will be Tikrit and he will be killed in the Masjid of Damascus; then Shuaib bin Salih will appear from Samarqand. Then the accursed Sufyani will appear from the Valley of Yabis, and he is from the progeny of Utbah bin Abu Sufyan; and when Sufyani appears, the Mahdi will go into occultation, after that he will appear.

key_terms.اخْتَفَى: He concealed himself / went into occultation

ai.seo_question: What are the specific signs and figures that appear before the rise of Imam Mahdi according to Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* details the chronological sequence of major eschatological figures, highlighting the specific geographic origins of Auf al-Salami (Jazira/Tikrit) and Shuaib bin Salih (Samarkand). It establishes a critical theological link where the Mahdi’s final occultation (*al-ghayb al-kubra*) coincides with the rise of the Sufyani, emphasizing the transition from hidden leadership to public manifestation amidst global turmoil.
